Name: Five Corners Farm - A Standalone Farm for Solo or Co-op
Author: ThatGirlFinley
Description:
[center][size=4]Welcome to:[/size]
[b][size=6]Five Corners Farm
[/size][/b][size=4]A standalone massive map for single-player or multiplayer.[/size][/center][size=4]
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/pfNXF8Q.gif[/img]


[b]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.6[/b]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Custom Farm Loader
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Train Station
[*]Extra Layers
[/list]
[b]Details:
[/b]This map's purpose is to provide players with a huge farm, with more variety and ways to play. It's suitable for about 4 or 5 players in co-op. It has two quarries, multiple different forage spots and a hardwood spawn as well as some great fishing spots.

This is my first attempt at creating a custom map for Stardew Valley so please be merciful. I've tested it, thoroughly and I'm fairly certain I've gotten rid of all of the glitches but let me know if you find any. Hopefully you find more joy playing on this map than I found when I was creating it, lol

Downloads.Description: Fixed a few bugs that inevitably cropped up while updating. (Map making is pretty tricky sometimes). Also sorted a transition from the river to the ocean. Fixed the steam animation of the minecarts too. Remember to make sure you have all the requirements.
